checks.name: versioned_read_and_write_boundaries
checks.result: 26/26 conditions in awr-security-paths version 1.0.0 passed: 6 source, 4 private runtime-helper and 4 actual CLI test functions. Includes traversal, absolute/file URI paths, prefix siblings, explicit relative/absolute external roots, permitted symlinks, replaced leaves/ancestors/discovered children, unauthorized manifests and Git paths, write source identity, bound external writes, runtime-owned sources and recovery aliases. Runtime tests independently verify directory-handle replacement and cleanup preserve outside source/temp traps, lock aliases cannot affect outside files, and exclusive snapshot creation preserves existing files.
criteria: 系统验证 ../、绝对路径、symlink escape 与显式授权 Root。
读取与写入均不能越过实际授权边界；拒绝结果可定位到来源。

checks.name: related_write_lifecycle
checks.result: 46 targeted CLI tests passed: proposal_cli 14, work_action_cli 10, work_complete_cli 12 and branch_close_cli 10. Claims, current source versions, dependency and completion proof, interruption recovery, atomic receipts and closure behavior remain enforced. The first branch suite run exposed a fixture using a noncanonical macOS /var path as an already-authorized Locator. Its report hash now uses fixture bytes directly; all actual product source/closure validations remain in place.

checks.name: mcp_stdio_contract
checks.result: 10 existing MCP stdio tests passed after the reader and writer changes, including actual source actions, reserved events, read immutability, current source refresh and evidence-bound completion.

checks.name: build_and_format
checks.result: Both executables built and the locked workspace with all targets, rustfmt and diff whitespace checks passed. One existing unused fixture-helper warning remains in awr-store/tests/support/mod.rs; no compilation error.

checks.name: actual_project_self_use
checks.result: Used the rebuilt MCP server to update this active work item on the project source ledger. Parsed source change is exactly the declared next_action; before/after recovery snapshots equal the actual file bytes, and no new temp file remains. The resulting 4982-token L1 context is complete. Doctor reports only the expected informational active_session while the current session is running.

checks.name: reviewed_authority_and_diagnostics
checks.result: Reviewed configured source authorization and exact-opening call sites. Authority remains in Locator/Manifest; canonical source paths are opened component by component without following later links. Temp creation, rename and cleanup hold one directory object. Lock and recovery snapshot access use held directories, no-follow opens and exclusive new files; snapshot size/fingerprints remain checked. Alias/recovery rejection is explicit and recovery/lock validation identifies the concrete path. Domain revision, claim, evidence, fingerprint and post-write verification checks remain intact.

acceptance.criterion: 系统验证 ../、绝对路径、symlink escape 与显式授权 Root。
读取与写入均不能越过实际授权边界；拒绝结果可定位到来源。

limitations: Local macOS component, real CLI/MCP stdio and current-project development self-use only; no E4 or released-product acceptance.
Unix symlink tests have been executed on macOS. Other platforms still need their separate platform gate; the matrix refuses to count missing conditions as passed.

Held directories retain the originally authorized directory object. Exact-opening primitives require prior authority resolution and do not grant access or replace source identity/fingerprint/revision checks.
The initial matrix run had a Rust fixture borrow-check error, fixed before the fully passing final run. Initial failed receipts are retained.
Broad concurrency/fault campaigns, remaining security topics, cross-platform validation, contractual metrics and release gates remain later ledger items.
